      <!DOCTYPE html>
      <html lang="en">
      <head>
      <meta chaet="UTF-8">
      <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
      <title>QuantEdge v4 — Live</title>
      <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=IBM+Plex+Mono:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,600;0,700;1,400&family=Barlow:wght@400;500;600;700;900&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
      <style>
      :root {
      --bg:#07090c; --s1:#0b0f14; --s2:#0f1520; --s3:#141d28;
      --b1:#1a2535; --b2:#243348; --b3:#2e4260;
      --cyan:#00d4ff; --cyan2:#0099rscc; --green:#00ff88; --green2:#00cc66;
      --red:#ff3355; --red2:#cc1133; --amber:#ffaa00; --amber2:#cc8800;
      --white:#e8f0f8; --t1:#d0e4f4; --t2:#8aaec8; --t3:#4e6e88; --t4:#2e4555;
      --mono:'IBM Plex Mono',monospace; --sans:'Barlow',sans-serif;
      }
      *{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;}
      html,body{height:100%;overflow:hidden;}
      body{background:var(--bg);color:var(--t1);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:16px;line-height:1.6;}
      ::-webkit-scrollbar{width:4px;height:4px;}
      ::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:transparent;}
      ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:var(--b2);border-radius:2px;}
      @keyframes blink{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:0.3}}
      @keyframes pulse{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:0.3}}
      @keyframes pulse-dot{0%,100%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}50%{opacity:0.4;transform:scale(0.6)}}
      @keyframes shimmer{0%,100%{opacity:0.7}50%{opacity:1}}
      /* ── X POST PANEL ── */
      #x-post-btn{position:fixed;bottom:80px;right:20px;width:48px;height:48px;
      background:var(--s1);border:1px solid var(--b1);border-radius:50%;
      display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;
      z-index:9999;font-size:20px;color:var(--t1);transition:all 0.2s;
      box-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);}
      #x-post-btn:hover{background:var(--cyan);color:#000;transform:scale(1.1);}
      #x-post-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,0.7);
      z-index:9998;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;}
      #x-post-overlay.open{display:flex;}
      #x-post-panel{background:var(--bg);border:1px solid var(--b1);border-radius:12px;
      width:520px;max-width:95vw;padding:20px;z-index:9999;max-height:90vh;overflow-y:auto;}
      #x-post-panel h3{color:var(--cyan);font-size:16px;margin-bottom:16px;
      display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;}
      .x-post-type-btns{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-bottom:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
      .x-post-type-btn{padding:6px 14px;border-radius:20px;border:1px solid var(--b1);
      background:var(--s1);color:var(--t2);cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;transition:all 0.2s;}
      .x-post-type-btn.active{background:var(--cyan);color:#000;border-color:var(--cyan);}
      .x-post-type-btn:hover{border-color:var(--cyan);color:var(--cyan);}
      #x-post-textarea{width:100%;min-height:180px;background:var(--s2);
      border:1px solid var(--b1);border-radius:8px;padding:12px;color:var(--t1);
      font-family:var(--sans);font-size:14px;line-height:1.6;resize:vertical;
      margin-bottom:8px;}
      #x-post-textarea:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--cyan);}
      #x-char-count{font-size:12px;color:var(--t3);text-align:right;margin-bottom:12px;}
      #x-char-count.over{color:var(--red);}
      .x-post-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:flex-end;flex-wrap:wrap;}
      .x-btn{padding:8px 18px;border-radius:8px;border:none;cursor:pointer;
      font-size:13px;font-weight:600;transition:all 0.2s;}
      .x-btn-generate{background:var(--s1);color:var(--cyan);border:1px solid var(--cyan);}
      .x-btn-generate:hover{background:var(--cyan);color:#000;}
      .x-btn-copy{background:var(--green);color:#000;}
      .x-btn-copy:hover{opacity:0.85;}
      .x-btn-close{background:var(--s1);color:var(--t2);border:1px solid var(--b1);}
      .x-btn-close:hover{border-color:var(--red);color:var(--red);}
      .x-trial-badge{background:var(--amber);color:#000;font-size:10px;font-weight:700;
      padding:2px 8px;border-radius:10px;margin-left:8px;}
      #x-copy-confirm{display:none;color:var(--green);font-size:12px;text-align:center;
      margin-top:8px;}
      /* TOPBAR */
      #topbar{height:54px;background:var(--s1);border-bottom:1px solid var(--b1);display:flex;align-items:center;padding:0 14px;gap:0;flex-shrink:0;}
      .logo{font-family:var(--sans);font-weight:900;font-size:22px;color:var(--cyan);letter-spacing:-1px;margin-right:8px;flex-shrink:0;}
      .logo-v{color:var(--t2);font-weight:400;font-size:14px;}
      .top-divider{width:1px;height:28px;background:var(--b2);margin:0 12px;flex-shrink:0;}
      #price-strip{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:center;flex:1;}
      .px-item{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:4px;}
      .px-sym{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1.5px;color:var(--t2);text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:600;}
      .px-val{font-size:17px;font-weight:700;color:var(--white);transition:color 0.3s;min-width:60px;}
      .px-val.up{color:var(--green);text-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(0,255,136,0.4);}
      .px-val.dn{color:var(--red);text-shadow:0 0 8px rgba(255,51,85,0.4);}
      .px-val.sm{font-size:14px;min-width:50px;}
      #clock-area{flex-shrink:0;text-align:right;}
      .clock-time{font-size:18px;font-weight:600;color:var(--cyan);letter-spacing:1px;}
      .clock-status{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:2px;text-transform:uppercase;}
      .clock-countdown{font-size:10px;color:var(--t2);letter-spacing:0.5px;margin-top:1px;}
      .status-open{color:var(--green);}.status-pre{color:var(--amber);}.status-after{color:var(--amber2);}.status-closed{color:var(--t3);}
      #pnl-strip{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:center;flex-shrink:0;}
      .pnl-item{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;}
      .pnl-label{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:1.5px;color:var(--t2);text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:600;}
      .pnl-val{font-size:16px;font-weight:700;}
      .pnl-val.pos{color:var(--green);}.pnl-val.neg{color:var(--red);}.pnl-val.neutral{color:var(--t1);}
      #rithmic-top{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:0 8px;cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0;}
      #rithmic-top-dot{width:8px;height:8px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--t4);transition:all 0.3s;}
      #rithmic-top-dot.live{background:var(--green);box-shadow:0 0 8px var(--green);animation:blink 2s infinite;}
      #rithmic-top-dot.conn{background:var(--amber);animation:blink 1s infinite;}
      #rithmic-top-dot.fail{background:var(--red);}
      #rithmic-top-label{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1px;color:var(--t3);text-transform:uppercase;}
      #master-badge{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:0 8px;border-left:1px solid var(--b2);}
      #topbar-score{font-size:20px;font-weight:900;font-family:var(--sans);color:var(--t4);}
      /* CAL BAR */
      #cal-bar{height:48px;background:var(--s2);border-bottom:1px solid var(--b1);flex-shrink:0;overflow:hidden;}
      .cal-bar-inner{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:0;height:100%;padding:0 14px;}
      .cal-bar-label{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:9px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--cyan);text-transform:uppercase;flex-shrink:0;margin-right:10px;}
      .cal-bar-divider{width:1px;height:18px;background:var(--b2);margin-right:10px;flex-shrink:0;}
      .cal-bar-events{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;flex:1;overflow:hidden;}
      .cal-bar-empty{font-size:11px;color:var(--t4);}
      .cal-bar-event{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:3px;border:1px solid var(--b2);background:var(--s3);white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0;font-size:13px;}
      .cal-bar-event.high{border-color:rgba(255,51,85,0.4);background:rgba(255,51,85,0.06);}
      .cal-bar-event.medium{border-color:rgba(255,170,0,0.3);background:rgba(255,170,0,0.04);}
      .cb-dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0;}
      .cal-bar-event.high .cb-dot{background:var(--red);box-shadow:0 0 4px var(--red);}
      .cal-bar-event.medium .cb-dot{background:var(--amber);}
      .cal-bar-event.low .cb-dot{background:var(--t3);}
      .cb-time{color:var(--cyan2);font-size:10px;}
      .cb-name{color:var(--t1);}
      .cal-bar-event.high .cb-name{color:var(--white);font-weight:600;}
      .cb-data{font-size:10px;color:var(--t3);margin-left:3px;}
      .cb-hist{font-size:10px;color:var(--amber);margin-left:4px;font-weight:700;background:rgba(255,170,0,0.1);padding:1px 5px;border-radius:3px;}
      .cal-bar-load{padding:3px 10px;background:var(--s3);border:1px solid var(--b2);border-radius:3px;color:var(--t2);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;cursor:pointer;transition:all 0.15s;flex-shrink:0;margin-left:8px;}
      .cal-bar-load:hover{color:var(--cyan);border-color:var(--cyan2);}
      /* BODY LAYOUT */
      #body{display:grid;grid-template-columns:560px 1fr;grid-template-rows:1fr auto;height:calc(100vh - 102px);overflow:hidden;}
      #left{grid-column:1;grid-row:1;border-right:1px solid var(--b1);overflow-y:auto;background:var(--s1);display:flex;flex-direction:column;}
      #right{grid-column:2;grid-row:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;background:var(--bg);}
      #viz-panel{grid-column:1/-1;grid-row:2;}
      /* VIZ PANEL */
      #viz-panel{border-top:1px solid var(--b1);background:var(--s1);display:flex;flex-direction:column;height:280px;flex-shrink:0;overflow:hidden;}
      #viz-panel.collapsed{height:32px;}
      #viz-toolbar{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:5px 12px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--b1);background:var(--s2);flex-shrink:0;overflow-x:auto;}
      .viz-title{font-family:var(--sans);font-size:10px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:2px;color:var(--cyan);text-transform:uppercase;flex-shrink:0;margin-right:4px;}
      .viz-divider{width:1px;height:16px;background:var(--b2);flex-shrink:0;margin:0 4px;}
      .layer-btn{padding:3px 9px;border-radius:3px;border:1px solid var(--b2);background:var(--s3);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:10px;color:var(--t3);cursor:pointer;transition:all 0.15s;white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0;}
      .layer-btn:hover{color:var(--t1);border-color:var(--b3);}
      .layer-btn.on{color:var(--white);}
      .layer-btn.on.l-session{background:rgba(255,170,0,0.2);border-color:var(--amber2);color:var(--amber);}
      .layer-btn.on.l-vwap{background:rgba(0,212,255,0.15);border-color:var(--cyan2);color:var(--cyan);}
      .layer-btn.on.l-volume{background:rgba(0,153,204,0.15);border-color:var(--cyan2);color:var(--cyan2);}
      .layer-btn.on.l-structure{background:rgba(147,51,234,0.15);border-color:#7c3aed;color:#a78bfa;}
      .layer-btn.on.l-sessions{background:rgba(100,100,100,0.2);border-color:var(--t3);color:var(--t2);}
      .layer-btn.on.l-fibs{background:rgba(255,170,0,0.15);border-color:var(--amber2);color:var(--amber2);}
      .viz-collapse-btn{margin-left:4px;padding:3px 10px;background:var(--s3);border:1px solid var(--b3);border-radius:3px;color:var(--t1);font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0;transition:all 0.15s;font-weight:600;}
      .viz-collapse-btn:hover{color:var(--white);border-color:var(--cyan2);background:var(--b2);}
      #viz-status{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:3px 12px;background:var(--bg);border-bottom:1px solid var(--b1);flex-shrink:0;font-size:10px;}
      `📈 ES SESSION RECAP — ${date}
      Result: [Win / Loss / Scratch]
      Entry: [price] → Exit: [price]
      P&L: [+/- points]
      What worked: [1 sentence]
      What I learned: [1 sentence]
      Tracking every trade publicly 🎯
      #ES_F #TradingJournal #Futures`;
      } else {
      ta.value = '';
      ta.placeholder = 'Type your custom post here...';
      ta.focus();
      }
      updateCharCount();
      document.getElementById('x-copy-confirm').style.display = 'none';
      }
      function copyXPost() {
      const ta = document.getElementById('x-post-textarea');
      if (!ta.value.trim()) {
      alert('Generate or write a post first.');
      return;
      }
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(ta.value).then(() => {
      const confirm = document.getElementById('x-copy-confirm');
      confirm.style.display = 'block';
      setTimeout(() => confirm.style.display = 'none', 3000);
      });
      }
      </script>
      <!-- ── X POST PANEL ── -->
      <button id="x-post-btn" title="Create X Post" onclick="openXPanel()">𝕏</button>
      <div id="x-post-overlay" onclick="closeXPanelOverlay(event)">
      <div id="x-post-panel">
      <h3>𝕏 Post Creator <span class="x-trial-badge">TRIAL MODE</span></h3>
      <div class="x-post-type-btns">
      <button class="x-post-type-btn active" onclick="setXPostType('bias',this)">📊 Morning Bias</button>
      <button class="x-post-type-btn" onclick="setXPostType('gex',this)">🎯 GEX Levels</button>
      <button class="x-post-type-btn" onclick="setXPostType('alert',this)">⚡ Trade Alert</button>
      <button class="x-post-type-btn" onclick="setXPostType('recap',this)">📈 Session Recap</button>
      <button class="x-post-type-btn" onclick="setXPostType('custom',this)">✏️ Custom</button>
      </div>
      <textarea id="x-post-textarea"
      placeholder="Click Generate to create a post from your current analysis data, or type your own..."
      oninput="updateCharCount()"></textarea>
      <div id="x-char-count">0 / 280</div>
      <div class="x-post-actions">
      <button class="x-btn x-btn-generate" onclick="generateXPost()">⚡ Generate</button>
      <button class="x-btn x-btn-copy" onclick="copyXPost()">📋 Copy to Clipboard</button>
      <button class="x-btn x-btn-close" onclick="closeXPanel()">✕ Close</button>
      </div>
      <div id="x-copy-confirm">✅ Copied! Paste into X when ready.</div>
      <div style="margin-top:12px;padding:10px;background:var(--s2);border-radius:6px;
      font-size:11px;color:var(--t3);border-left:3px solid var(--amber);">
      ⚠️ Trial mode — review all posts carefully before publishing to X.
      Edit freely before copying.
      </div>
      </div>
      </div>
      </body>
      </html>
